caption: Our test group in the web app with six support replies, each with its own abbreviation.
Snippet Activity keeps the text of a deleted snippet, with a Restore button.
After Restore the log shows the snippet as Restored. During the trial the history could be filtered to the last 24 hours or 7 days.
Billing after sign up: Individual (Trial) until 22 Dec 2026, with no card on file.
Team features need an Organization account, which went straight to a plan picker with Purchase: Pro, Business and Enterprise, yearly prices in euros on 22 Nov 2026.
Start subscription on the individual account offered only an Individual plan marked Legacy, at EUR 4.64 a month billed monthly.
